task: Compare M8 and M9 exact solvers on the same existing small benchmark instance
selection_reason: Existing 7-customer case with two satellites; S01 has only one satellite and cannot show free-assignment effects.
calendar_domain: native input clock with per-count equal-partition refinement; no extra decision grid
method_note: Pure direct Gurobi unified MILP; compact is an equivalent expression. Do not infer optimality from a time-limited feasible result.

additional_diagnostic.reason: Native all-K M9 returned no incumbent within 300 seconds; M8 proved optimal with K=2.
additional_diagnostic.proof_scope: K=2 only. Separately verify the obtained schedule is feasible in the native K=1..7 M9 domain.
